feeds.title: The Iowa Federation of Republican Women Blog
feeds.description: Engaging Republican women of Iowa in the political process since 1939. The Iowa Federation of Republican Women (IowaFRW) was founded in 1939 in Tama County. One club quickly spread into a vast expansion of clubs throughout the state of Iowa.
